about:
REPOWER by Solar Universe Northeast PA operates from Mountain Top, Pennsylvania. The business traces its roots to 1988 when Tony and Susie Delldonna began a home construction company. In 2009 they added solar photovoltaic installation to their services, leveraging decades of building experience to integrate rooftop and ground-mount arrays.

The company provides full-service solar PV installation for residential and commercial customers. Its crew handles site assessment, system design, permitting, utility interconnection, and incentive paperwork. Installations range from roof-mounted arrays to ground-mount systems, including retrofits with microinverter technology. The team also provides post-installation monitoring support and warranty service.

Customers include homeowners throughout northeastern Pennsylvania and small businesses seeking to reduce electricity costs. Testimonials reference projects in Jefferson Township and other local communities, with system sizes such as 10.2 kW and 12.06 kW arrays. The company works directly with property owners and coordinates with excavators and utility inspectors.

The Delldonnas emphasize hands-on project management, noting they navigate supply-chain disruptions and bureaucratic hurdles on behalf of clients. Clients cite the firm’s practice of delivering a comprehensive warranty binder, competitive quotes with fixed timelines, and the ability to complete complex retrofits in a single day.
